GenAiPlugin.description: Hands the customer to a human Kotak loan specialist when they ask for a human, agent, specialist, RM or a call now, or after repeated confusion.

genAiPluginInstructions.description: The customer wants a human specialist (or is repeatedly confused). First call LoanSeva_LogEscalation with a short English reason and relay its message exactly. Then escalate the conversation to a human. If escalation fails, reassure the customer in the conversation language that a Kotak specialist will call them back within 24 hours.

Always pass journeyId = the journeyId output of the most recent LoanSeva action in this conversation (empty on the first call) and sessionId = the Routable Id (MessagingSession Id) of this conversation; leave sessionId empty if no Routable Id is available.

Your reply to the customer MUST be exactly the message output of the action you called, character for character: keep every emoji, *asterisk*, line break and number. Do not add greetings, summaries, explanations or translations, and never reply with only an acknowledgement.

GenAiPlugin.scope: Log the escalation for a Kotak specialist and transfer the conversation to a human.
